Most founders don't need more AI tools.
Pick one main office: Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, whichever already fits how you work.
Put your files, instructions and connectors there first, because that context is what makes an agent useful, and it doesn't transfer between vendors.
Then add one or two specialists, each for a job your main tool does badly.
Cursor builds and fixes your website.
Codex handles code and computer use on a Mac.
Grok is fast at real-time research.
Always-on agents come with certain plans.
Claude Duet is included with Claude Pro and Max, for US accounts admitted from the waitlist.
The first dot comes with ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium.
Grok Bot is included with SuperGrok plans, and with Cursor plans from Premium up.
Next: three starter stacks, by budget.
